name: Force Meat Balls for Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one cupful of cooked veal or fowl meat, minced
ingredients.originalText: one cupful of cooked veal or fowl meat, minced
ingredients.quantityText: one cupful of cooked veal or fowl meat, minced

ingredients.name: handful of fine bread crumbs
ingredients.originalText: a handful of fine bread crumbs

ingredients.name: the yolks of four hard-boiled eggs
ingredients.originalText: the yolks of four hard-boiled eggs

instructions.text: Mix the minced meat with a handful of fine bread crumbs, the yolks of four hard-boiled eggs rubbed smooth together with a tablespoon of milk.
Add a half teaspoon of flour, and bind all together with two beaten eggs.
Well flour the hands, and make the mixture into little balls the size of a nutmeg.
Drop into the soup about twenty minutes before serving.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix the minced meat with a handful of fine bread crumbs, the yolks of four hard-boiled eggs rubbed smooth together with a tablespoon of milk.
2. Season with pepper and salt.
3. Add a half teaspoon of flour, and bind all together with two beaten eggs.
4. Well flour the hands, and make the mixture into little balls the size of a nutmeg.
5. Drop into the soup about twenty minutes before serving.
